reading: The sketch lays out a three-column Gmail-like webmail app: a flat left navigation panel, a middle email-list column with a search box and seven message rows, and a right-hand email-detail pane with header, sender info, body text, two attachment cards, and Reply/Forward buttons. Typed notes give exact colors, sizes, and copy for every part.
